capabilities: Render .pptx slides from OOXML without an external converter
Edit slide text and shapes in place and save the deck
Present decks full-screen with transitions and timers
Embed whole decks or single slides in notes
Extract decks to Markdown and export slides as PNG or PDF
disambiguation: Not a deck generator; it opens, edits and inspects existing .pptx files already in the vault.
extras: On first save a one-off copy is written beside the deck as <name>.pptx.bak, and saving is refused if the file changed on disk. Interface follows Obsidian's display language, with English and Japanese available.
problem: .pptx is not a format Obsidian opens, so a deck in the vault is invisible in the file explorer and cannot be linked to or embedded.

relations.evidence: View, edit and save PowerPoint decks without leaving Obsidian.

summary: PowerPoint deck viewer and editor that renders .pptx slides from OOXML, with in-place editing, slide embeds, Markdown extraction and PNG/PDF export.
